HOMERES Police National Training Institute Regional Training School 8 Kuta Kankabato, San Jose, Tacloban City Dear POI Homeres: This pertains to your letter requesting for a clarification/legal opinion relative to DILG Department Order No. 2009-321 dated 13 March 2009 in relation to Section 73 of the Implementing Rules and Regulations of Republic Act No. 6975. Per your letter, on June 14, 20111 Special Order Nos. 1024, 1023 and 1022 were issued by PRO 8 reassigning you to Northern Samar Police Provincial Office, Eastern Samar Police Provincial Office and Samar Police Provincial Office respectively, effective on the above-mentioned date. However, when you asked permission from the Regional Training Director to leave PPSC-RTS8 and assume your respective new assignment at the said provincial police offices in compliance with the above- mentioned orders, you were advised by the Regional Training Director to Maintain Status Quo in view of the exigency ofthe service. On August 91 2011, you (Catherine D. Homeres) have been served with a copy of dropped from the Rolls Order No. 95 and POI Amelita B. Patrimonio and Edwin Palareja have been subjected to administrative investigations for AWOL with all your pay and allowances having been unduly withheld without any final judgment finding you guilty of the charge. In reply thereto, please be informed that DILG Department Order No. 2009-321 signed by the then Usec. Marius P. Corpus cannot be revoked by mere issuance of a PNP Special Order. The said DILG Department Order shall only be revoked by the issuance of another Department Order signed by the SILG or his duly authorized representative revoking the above-mentioned Department Order. Be that as it mayt since the Order dropping you from the rolls has already been served and POI Patrimonio and POI Palereja was already charged for AWOL, you are hereby advised to exhaust all the administrative remedies applicable to your respective case pursuant to the existing laws and Napolcom Circulars by filing your appeal or Motion for Reconsideration with the proper forum whether to the PNP Regional Director of PNP Region 8, to the Regional Appellate Board or with the Chief PNP. Please be guided accordingly. POI Amelita Patrimonio Philippine Public Safety College Police National Training Institute Regional Training School 8 Kuta Kankabato, San Jose, Tacloban City Very truly yoorst ATTY. JESUS DO W Director Ill POI Edwin Palareja Philippine Public Safety College Police National Training Institute Regional Training School 8 Kuta Kankabato, San Jose, Tacloban City LS:94/11
